nli.interpretation: Selected-pair scientific NLI behavior, not human scientific entailment labels

unassigned_categories.DECOMPOSITION_INCORRECT: Requires manual adjudication; no false claim of exhaustive ground truth
unassigned_categories.DECOMPOSITION_MISSING_REQUIREMENT: No independently annotated decomposition target; zero explicit requirements is not automatically a failure
unassigned_categories.COMPARISON_ATTRIBUTION_FAILURE: Requires trace adjudication; rule-role distributions and controlled probes reported separately
